micro.purpose: The queue ring numeral only. 11px at 600.

meta.purpose: Timestamps, counts, badges, hints. 12px; tabular figures where numbers tick.

label.purpose: Secondary lines, hints, speaker label, composer chips, segmented options, sidebar dividers. 13px at 500.

ui.purpose: Chrome: rows, buttons, table cells, settings titles, the phone header title. 14px.

body.purpose: Assistant prose and markdown. 16px at 1.7; 1.75 from the sm breakpoint.

body-wide.purpose: The same 16px body from 640px up, at line-height 1.75.

user-message.purpose: The user bubble. 16px at 1.55, tighter because it is short.

input.purpose: Every focusable text field. 16px floor (max(16px, 16px x font-scale)) so iOS never zooms.

title.purpose: Header title from sm, dialog titles, sidebar wordmark. 17px at 600.

code.purpose: Code blocks, tool names, paths and values. System mono, 13px at 1.65.

shadows.name: shadow-hairline
shadows.purpose: A ring and nothing else; image and well edges.

shadows.name: shadow-card
shadows.purpose: Cards, code blocks, queued rows. Ring only.

shadows.name: shadow-btn
shadows.purpose: Secondary pill buttons and the active segmented option.

shadows.name: shadow-raised
shadows.purpose: The composer and the jump-to-latest button, floating over the thread.

shadows.name: shadow-overlay
shadows.purpose: Menus, popovers, dialogs, the drawer, toasts.

shadows.name: shadow-inset-field
shadows.value: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--line); fields use var(--line-strong), var(--ink-3) on focus
shadows.purpose: Text inputs drawn as an inset ring instead of a border.

motion.name: ease-out-strong
motion.purpose: Anything entering: fades, rises, pops, switch knob, disclosure.

motion.name: ease-drawer
motion.purpose: Anything sliding in from an edge (the sidebar drawer).

motion.name: duration-quick
motion.purpose: Scrim fades, menu pop-in, control transitions and press scale.

motion.name: duration-fast
motion.purpose: Cards, dialogs, toasts, the sheet, the switch.

motion.name: duration-medium
motion.purpose: Turn and row entrances, the drawer.

motion.name: duration-slow
motion.purpose: Assistant turn fade-up, disclosure expand. The ceiling for anything a person triggers.

motion.name: press-scale
motion.value: 0.97 buttons; 0.96 to 0.94 small icon and circle controls; 0.98 to 0.99 rows
motion.purpose: Active-state feedback; there is no hover movement.

motion.name: keyframes
motion.value: fade-up (8px), fade-in, pop-in (0.95 to 1), panel-in-right, toast-in, shake 400ms, caret-blink, pulse-dot, pixel-on, spin
motion.purpose: Declared at the top level of globals.css, never inside @theme.

motion.name: reduce-motion

motion.purpose: Merged from the in-app switch and the OS setting before first paint.

narrative.overview:
A familiar chat client played straight, judged against the ChatGPT app and not against a distinctive world. One calm column of prose and bubbles, a sidebar one step darker than the page, a pill composer that floats over the thread's last line. The system's whole job is to get out of the way of long agent replies, code and tool output, and to make three things visible without hunting: a live run, a pending approval, an unread scheduled report.

The palette is hue-free grey; the faces are the platform's own (SF Pro and SF Mono on Apple, a system fallback elsewhere), so there is nothing to download on a phone. Depth is value in dark and ring plus soft drop in light. Hue is rationed to states that ask something of you. Density is generous where reading happens (16px at 1.7 to 1.75, 28 to 36px between turns) and compact where chrome lives (14px, 36px rows). The look it rejects is the pre-redesign one: 12 to 13px chrome, a web font on a flat grey ramp, a cramped thread.
keyCharacteristics: One reading column, 768px max, centred; the sidebar is a permanent 272px column from `lg`, a drawer below.
Surfaces separate by value, not outline: sidebar #0b0b0b < page #141414 < raised #252525 in dark.
Ink is the accent. Primary actions are ink-on-page pills; there is no brand hue.
Hue only as signal: orange for waiting on you, red for failure and danger. Completed states are neutral.
Pill and circle controls (full radius) for actions; 10px rounded rectangles for rows and fields; 28px composer, 22px bubbles.
Motion is short ease-out fades and small rises, capped at 300ms, with no bounce.

rules.name: The Hue-Is-A-Signal Rule
rules.body: Hue means the run needs you (orange) or something failed (red). A running run is shown by a neutral `ink-2` pulsing dot, and a completed tool call is a quiet `ink-3` check. Completed, on, and ordinary-success states are neutral; do not tint them.

rules.name: The Value-Not-Outline Rule
rules.body: In dark, separation comes from the step between #0b0b0b, #141414 and #252525. A raised surface gets at most a 6 to 8% white ring, never a visible border.

rules.name: The Ink-Is-The-Accent Rule
rules.body: The primary action is `ink` on `page` (near-white pill in dark, near-black in light). Do not introduce a brand colour for buttons, links or selection.

rules.name: The 16-Floor Rule
rules.body: Any text field a thumb can focus is 16px or larger, or iOS Safari zooms the viewport and never zooms back. The only step down is the sidebar's filter and rename fields on `pointer: fine`, which drop to 14px; touch stays 16.

rules.name: The Sentence-Case Rule
rules.body: Labels, section dividers and speaker names are sentence case at label size in `ink-2` or `ink-3`. There is no uppercase, no letter-spacing and no eyebrow style anywhere in the system.

rules.name: The Numbers Align Rule
rules.body: Anything that ticks or sits in a column sets `tabular-nums` (timers, counts, times, table cells); a table column whose every filled cell is numeric is right-aligned.

rules.name: The Measured Shell Rule
rules.body: The shell's height is measured, not declared: `window.innerHeight` becomes `--app-height`, and `h-app` reads it. `dvh` and `visualViewport` are never the source.

rules.name: The One Column Rule
rules.body: Reading and composing share one centred 768px column. Wide content (tables, code, commands) scrolls inside its own box instead of widening the column.

rules.name: The Flat-At-Rest Rule
rules.body: Beyond a 1px ring and the faint contact shadow under secondary buttons, only the composer, the jump-to-latest button and overlays cast a drop. Rows, bubbles and assistant prose carry no shadow and no border.

rules.name: The Role Radius Rule
rules.body: Radius follows role, not size: pills for actions, 10px for rows and fields, 16px for containers that hold content, 22px for a bubble, 28px for the composer. A new surface picks the tier of what it is.

rules.name: The Anchored Overlay Rule
rules.body: An overlay opens from, or is anchored to, the thing that summoned it: menus from their trigger, the thinking menu from its chip, the composer menu from the composer, dialogs bottom-anchored on a phone. Nothing floats at an arbitrary position.

dos: **Do** separate dark surfaces by value: #0b0b0b sidebar, #141414 page, #252525 raised, and keep the ring on raised surfaces at 6 to 8% white.
**Do** keep hue for states that ask something of the reader: `orange` for waiting, `red` for failure and destructive actions. Show running with the neutral pulsing dot.
**Do** make the primary action an ink-on-page pill and every other action a ghost or ring-secondary pill.
**Do** use the type tokens (`text-meta`, `text-label`, `text-ui`, `text-body`, `text-input`, `text-title`) and never an arbitrary pixel size, so the text-size preference moves everything together.
**Do** keep text fields at 16px on touch, and keep sizes in px so the shell ignores the browser root size.
**Do** size the shell with `h-app`, pay `pt-safe` / `pb-safe` / `px-safe` on every edge surface, and anchor overlays with `inset-x-0 top-0 h-app`.

**Do** declare every animation through a top-level keyframe and a duration token (`--duration-quick` 150, `--duration-fast` 200, `--duration-medium` 250, `--duration-slow` 300) with `--ease-out-strong` (`cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1)`); use `--ease-drawer` (`cubic-bezier(0.32, 0.72, 0, 1)`) for anything that slides in from an edge.
**Do** give every control a press response: scale 0.97 for buttons, 0.96 to 0.94 for small icon and circle controls, 0.98 to 0.99 for rows.
**Do** put a 44px `tap-target` on anything drawn smaller, and reveal hover-only actions permanently on touch.
**Do** build generated Markdown as React elements only; user text stays literal.
**Do** keep tool names, paths and command text in mono and everything else in the UI face.
donts: **Don't** use `dvh` or `visualViewport` to size the shell, `sticky` or `fixed` for the composer, or `fixed inset-0` for a bottom-anchored overlay.
**Don't** tint completed, enabled or ordinary-success states, and don't add a brand hue to buttons or links.
**Don't** add outlines to raised surfaces in dark, or drop shadows to rows, bubbles or prose.
**Don't** add uppercase, tracked or eyebrow labels, gradient text, glyph characters standing in for icons, or a web font.

**Don't** declare keyframes inside `@theme`, run an entrance or transition longer than 300ms, add bounce, or put a filter or blur over long text (it was removed from the resolving state because it repaints on a phone). Looping status indicators are the only animation allowed to run longer.
**Don't** widen the thread past 768px; wide tables and code scroll inside their own box instead.
**Don't** edit the `NO_FLASH` pre-paint script without matching `applyPrefsToDocument()`.
**Don't** let a hue appear only in colour: pair it with a label or shape (the Waiting and Blocked badges carry text).
